plugin.name: Magpie
plugin.description: Connect the magpie gateway running on this computer to Astravia: read its model catalog, publish it as a model provider, and use any of those models in chat.
view.label: Magpie Gateway
view.description: Models served by the magpie gateway on this computer
settings.title: Connection
settings.baseUrlHint: Leave it alone unless magpie was started with a different MAGPIE_ADDR.
settings.apiKeyHint: Only needed when magpie was started outside this computer. Anything works from this computer, so the default stays as it is.
models.title: Models on this gateway
models.empty: The gateway answered with an empty catalog. Add a provider in magpie first.
runtime.title: Local runtime
runtime.phase.checking: Looking for magpie on this computer…
runtime.phase.running: The gateway is running under this plugin
runtime.phase.failed: Install or start did not succeed
runtime.progress.contacting: Reading the release info — the download starts in a moment…
runtime.progress.hint: This refreshes every second. You can switch panels and come back to it.
runtime.failed: The command did not succeed. One line of its own output is below.
runtime.unsupported: This platform has no official command-line build; use the vendor installer.
runtime.feedFailed: Could not read the release information from usemagpie.ai. Check the network and try again.
runtime.installFailed: Installation failed; any magpie already on this computer was left untouched.
runtime.startFailed: Start failed; the gateway did not come up.
runtime.exited: The gateway process exited. The exit code and its own log line are below; the installed app's own persistent mode is the alternative.
runtime.note: The gateway is a child process of this plugin: it stops when Astravia quits. Nothing is written outside your home directory, no sudo, and your PATH is left alone. To keep it running across logins, run magpie daemon install in a terminal once it is installed.
runtime.manual: Or install it with the official installer
note.title: What this plugin does not do
note.body: It does not hold your provider keys and does not choose models for you — those stay in magpie's own configuration on this computer. It reads the gateway's catalog and, when you ask it to, writes those models into Astravia's model picker.
error.unreachable: No answer from the gateway; is magpie running?
error.timeout: The gateway took too long to answer
error.notMagpie: Something answered at that address, but not a magpie gateway
error.http: The gateway answered with an error
error.syncFailed: Could not publish the models; nothing was changed
error.emptyModels: The catalog is empty, so nothing was written to Astravia
status.offlineHint: Check Runtime on the right: install the official binary and start it there — the port matches the address above.
models.name: Model
models.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} rows; narrow it with the filter.
runtime.noShell: Neither sh nor powershell exists on this machine, so the plugin cannot run any command.
runtime.noShellHint: On Windows this usually means PowerShell was removed or PATH is broken; on macOS/Linux it means /bin/sh is unavailable.
runtime.deniedHint: Allow sh (macOS/Linux) or powershell (Windows) under Settings → Plugins → Magpie → Commands.
